# Design beautiful emails with Email Creator

Sending emails is always a useful marketing channel for every shop owner. Even with traditional emails like transaction confirmation, notifications, new registration confirmation, etc, you will have the opportunities to encourage repeat sales. Fortunately, WooCommerce provides built-in functionality that automatically sends customers emails. You can also modify the default email templates right from the WooCommerce settings page. If you don't know it yet, please check this documentation.


## Default WooCommerce Emails

If you aren't familiar with customizing WooCommerce emails, you can read this article: [How to Customize WooCommerce Emails](https://woocommerce.com/posts/how-to-customize-emails-in-woocommerce/). You are able to change the color, font and add the brand image. However, these options are still very limited. Your emails would become tedious, while email marketing must be succinct, with enticing design. In order to set your store apart from hundreds of other WooCommerce stores, you need to polish your emails. And, Email Creator can help you do so. 


## Email Creator - Professional WooCommerce Email Templates

There are many plugins (freemium and premium) out there that help you design your emails. In this tutorial, we're going to introduce the plugin [**Email Creator - Professional WooCommerce Email Templates**](https://emailcreator.app/). This plugin will help you transfer the basic (and boring) email templates of WooCommerce into an appealing and professional look.

From building brand awareness to driving leads for your store, this plugin can do them all. It help you creating engaging emails easily to grow your brand and sell more stuff. Compare to basic email templates of WooCommerce and other plugins, there are some benefits we could share with you.


### Designing emails with ease and smooth

This plugin provides an user-friendly interface and smoothly integrate with WordPress. With us, the most poweful feature is the template library. Instead of starting from crafts, we can pick a template from a variety of drag-and-drop email templates. It helps us save a lot of time but the final result is much better than what we expected.


### Increase sales with automated follow-up emails.

This plugin helps you to create automated emails with rules for different segments. It is a great opportunity to introduce your brand, upsell products, ask for customer feedback, or deliver important instructions relating to a customer’s specific order.

Personalize your emails according to whether they’re a new customer, the exact products they purchased, or by the product’s category. Then schedule your emails to be automatically sent or X days/weeks following purchase.


### Recover abandoned carts

Win back lost sales with a series of abandoned cart emails. Cart Abandonment emails have been proved to increase conversion rates by 24%! You can remind customers of the contents of their cart and encourage them to return to purchase automatically.  


### Building a long customer relationship with tailored content

Besides the professional email designs which will improve the customer's trust, this plugin also gives you the option to add a product recommendation section that auto-import products from your store. From your customers' purchase history and behavior, you can give them the offers that they can't ignore.


### Grow your email list

This plugin is also integrated with MyShopKit’s popup plugin. It helps you encourage visitors to join your mailing list by creating an eye-catching signup form. One thing worth mentioning is that you can decide when, what, which page, and to whom the popup appears.
